title: 真实远程JWKS轮换：未知kid不强制刷新，重叠窗口与JWT独立缓存分别验收
body:
## 操作任务
实现configure(base)，返回深拷贝，仅把remote提供者remote_jwks.cache_duration改为批准实验预算1s，并移除其jwt_cache_config；其他issuer/audience/Authorization提取、健康例外、过滤顺序及cluster全部保留。验收先独立复现JWT缓存使旧令牌在公钥删除及JWKS过期后仍被接受；再验证修复配置下先公布新公钥、缓存过期后新旧令牌共存、删除旧key后旧缓存短时仍允许、再次刷新后拒绝旧签名。统计真实取钥HTTP次数，证明未知kid在有效旧缓存期间不能被当作立即刷新开关。取钥服务500且缓存过期须拒绝业务，恢复后新令牌继续有效；错误issuer/audience、过期或未知key仍拒绝。实验1s预算及禁用JWT缓存是本题批准选择，不是生产通用配置建议。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
实际Envoy1.36.13单worker、私有回环HTTP JWKS服务、RSA2048/RS256签名；两层缓存与真实单调时钟等待分别验证，不伪造时间或响应。公钥删除不等于立即会话撤销，JWT缓存控制用未过期令牌展示，不宣称等待其完整寿命。未验证生产身份系统、HTTPS取钥信任、OIDC discovery、多worker或多副本全部缓存收敛；即时撤销须另有独立策略。不新增宿主身份或联网依赖，不构建镜像，测试私钥仅临时进程内生成。
answer:
```python
import copy
def configure(base):
    result=copy.deepcopy(base)
    filters=result["static_resources"]["listeners"][0]["filter_chains"][0]["filters"][0]["typed_config"]["http_filters"]
    for item in filters:
        if item["name"]=="envoy.filters.http.jwt_authn":
            provider=item["typed_config"]["providers"]["remote"]
            provider["remote_jwks"]["cache_duration"]="1s"
            provider.pop("jwt_cache_config",None)
    return result
```

原题知识说明：
JWT验证依赖缓存或远程取得的公钥以及issuer、audience和时间约束，密钥轮换不应让发布者立即使用所有代理尚未获得的新key。应分别画出JWKS发布、缓存更新、令牌签发和旧key移除的时间线，测试未知kid和取钥服务不可用。移除公钥的传播并非瞬时，已验证令牌缓存也需按配置核验，不能把密钥删除当即时会话撤销。验收新旧合法令牌与错误受众、过期令牌，记录拒绝原因和刷新请求量。交付撤销时限与重叠窗口，强制失效需求必须有可验证的独立策略。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 解释过滤链、资源与协议的作用范围
交付专用请求矩阵和实际目标证据
明确版本、资源与失败策略

import base64,copy,http.server,json,pathlib,sys,threading,time
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path("checks").resolve()))
from envoy_native import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm,student
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa,padding
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes
print("NATIVE_LINUX_READY",flush=True)
import task
def b64(raw):return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).rstrip(b"=").decode()
keys={name:rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537,key_size=2048) for name in ["old","new","unknown"]}
def jwk(name):
 n=keys[name].public_key().public_numbers()
 def integer(value):return b64(value.to_bytes((value.bit_length()+7)//8,"big"))
 return dict(kty="RSA",alg="RS256",use="sig",kid=name,n=integer(n.n),e=integer(n.e))
now=int(time.time())
def token(name,nonce="",changes=None):
 claims=dict(iss="https://issuer.opsforge.invalid",aud="opsforge-api",sub="approved-user",iat=now,exp=now+300,jti=nonce)
 claims.update(changes or {})
 raw=b64(json.dumps(dict(alg="RS256",kid=name),separators=(",",":")).encode())+"."+b64(json.dumps(claims,separators=(",",":")).encode())
 return raw+"."+b64(keys[name].sign(raw.encode(),padding.PKCS1v15(),hashes.SHA256()))
class KeyServer:
 def __init__(self):self.keys=["old"];self.status=200;self.requests=[];self.lock=threading.Lock()
 def __enter__(self):
  owner=self
  class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
   def log_message(self,*args):pass
   def do_GET(self):
    with owner.lock:
     names=list(owner.keys);status=owner.status
     owner.requests.append(dict(path=self.path,kids=names,status=status,at=time.monotonic()))
    raw=json.dumps(dict(keys=[jwk(name) for name in names])).encode()
    self.send_response(status);self.send_header("Content-Type","application/json");self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(raw)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(raw)
  self.server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),Handler);self.port=self.server.server_port
  self.thread=threading.Thread(target=lambda:self.server.serve_forever(poll_interval=.02),daemon=True);self.thread.start();return self
 def __exit__(self,*args):self.server.shutdown();self.server.server_close();self.thread.join(2)
def provider(config):
 return next(item["typed_config"]["providers"]["remote"] for item in hcm(config)["http_filters"] if item["name"]=="envoy.filters.http.jwt_authn")
def call(server,signed):
 return server.request("/protected",headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+signed})[0]
def after_expiry():
 # Waiting is for the actual Envoy cache clock; responses are never simulated.
 time.sleep(1.15)
with Upstream() as upstream,KeyServer() as jwks:
 base=bootstrap(upstream.port)
 cluster=copy.deepcopy(base["static_resources"]["clusters"][0]);cluster["name"]="jwks"
 cluster["load_assignment"]["cluster_name"]="jwks"
 cluster["load_assignment"]["endpoints"][0]["lb_endpoints"][0]["endpoint"]["address"]["socket_address"]["port_value"]=jwks.port
 base["static_resources"]["clusters"].append(cluster)
 auth={"name":"envoy.filters.http.jwt_authn","typed_config":{"@type":"type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.jwt_authn.v3.JwtAuthentication",
  "providers":{"remote":{"issuer":"https://issuer.opsforge.invalid","audiences":["opsforge-api"],"clock_skew_seconds":0,
   "remote_jwks":{"http_uri":{"uri":"http://127.0.0.1:"+str(jwks.port)+"/jwks.json","cluster":"jwks","timeout":"0.2s"},"cache_duration":"600s"},
   "jwt_cache_config":{"jwt_cache_size":100},"forward":False,"from_headers":[{"name":"Authorization","value_prefix":"Bearer "}]}},
  "rules":[{"match":{"path":"/health"}},{"match":{"prefix":"/"},"requires":{"provider_name":"remote"}}]}}
 hcm(base)["http_filters"].insert(0,auth)
 hcm(base)["route_config"]["virtual_hosts"][0]["routes"].insert(0,{"match":{"path":"/health"},"direct_response":{"status":200,"body":{"inline_string":"ready"}}})
 # Independent control: valid JWT cache can outlive JWKS expiry/removal.
 cached=copy.deepcopy(base);provider(cached)["remote_jwks"]["cache_duration"]="1s"
 old=token("old","stable");new=token("new","stable")
 with Envoy(cached) as server:
  assert call(server,old)==200
  fetched=len(jwks.requests);jwks.keys=["new"];after_expiry()
  assert call(server,old)==200 and len(jwks.requests)==fetched,"expected independently cached JWT"
  assert call(server,token("old","not-cached"))==401 and len(jwks.requests)==fetched+1
 print("NATIVE_REMOTE_JWKS_REMOVAL_DOES_NOT_INSTANTLY_REVOKE_SEPARATELY_CACHED_VALID_JWT",flush=True)
 jwks.keys=["old"];jwks.status=200
 before=copy.deepcopy(base);fixed=student(task.configure,base);assert base==before
 expected=copy.deepcopy(base);provider(expected)["remote_jwks"]["cache_duration"]="1s";provider(expected).pop("jwt_cache_config")
 assert fixed==expected,"only the approved cache settings may change"
 timeline=[]
 with Envoy(fixed) as server:
  start=len(jwks.requests)
  assert call(server,old)==200 and len(jwks.requests)==start+1
  jwks.keys=["old","new"]
  assert call(server,new)==401 and len(jwks.requests)==start+1,"new kid incorrectly assumed to force an immediate refetch"
  timeline.append(dict(stage="new-published-but-old-cache",old=call(server,old),new=401,fetches=len(jwks.requests)-start))
  after_expiry();assert call(server,new)==200 and call(server,old)==200 and len(jwks.requests)==start+2
  timeline.append(dict(stage="overlap-after-refresh",old=200,new=200,fetches=len(jwks.requests)-start))
  jwks.keys=["new"]
  assert call(server,old)==200 and len(jwks.requests)==start+2
  after_expiry();count=len(upstream.requests)
  assert call(server,old)==401 and len(upstream.requests)==count and len(jwks.requests)==start+3
  assert call(server,new)==200
  timeline.append(dict(stage="old-removed-and-cache-refreshed",old=401,new=200,fetches=len(jwks.requests)-start))
  # Cached valid keys temporarily work during an outage; expired-key fetch failure must deny.
  jwks.status=500;assert call(server,new)==200
  after_expiry();count=len(upstream.requests);fetches=len(jwks.requests)
  assert call(server,new)==401 and len(upstream.requests)==count and len(jwks.requests)>fetches
  jwks.status=200;assert call(server,new)==200
  timeline.append(dict(stage="fetch-failure-denied-and-provider-restored",new=200,fetches=len(jwks.requests)-start))
  count=len(upstream.requests)
  rejected_statuses=[]
  for bad in [token("unknown"),token("new",changes={"aud":"other"}),token("new",changes={"iss":"https://other.invalid"}),token("new",changes={"exp":now-600})]:
   status=call(server,bad);rejected_statuses.append(status)
   assert status in (401,403),("invalid identity reached business",status)
  assert server.request("/protected")[0]==401 and len(upstream.requests)==count
  assert server.request("/health")[:2]==(200,b"ready") and len(upstream.requests)==count
  assert not any(name.lower()=="authorization" for row in upstream.requests for name in row["headers"])
 print("NATIVE_REMOTE_JWKS_NEW_KID_PREPUBLICATION_OVERLAP_OLD_KEY_RETIREMENT_FETCH_COUNTS_AND_FAIL_CLOSED "+json.dumps(dict(timeline=timeline,rejected_statuses=rejected_statuses)),flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
